quest.event.daily.message.11101: Time for another day of hard work!
quest.event.daily.message.11102: Time for Mama to roll up her sleeves and get to it!
quest.event.daily.message.11103: Better hurry up or Mama will beat you to it!
quest.event.daily.message.11104: Put it off until later and you'll just forget about it... I always do.
quest.event.daily.message.11105: Let's jump to it and get it done!
quest.event.daily.message.11106: The most certain path to success is to do a little bit every single day.
quest.event.daily.message.11107: Come on, it's time for today's daily challenges!
quest.event.daily.message.11108: Time to pull out all the stops!
quest.event.daily.message.11109: Don't procrastinate! Just jump in and finish it off.
quest.event.daily.message.11110: There are no days off when it comes to busting baddies!
quest.event.daily.message.11111: Event quests and the main story are fun, but don't forget your daily challenges!
quest.event.daily.message.11112: How about you finish this up now? It won't take long!
quest.event.daily.message.11114: Are you here to take care of some daily challenges?
quest.event.daily.message.11115: Good morning! Or, uh, good evening? Which is it?
quest.event.daily.message.11116: No better way to start your day than by beating some bad guys! ...Wait, is it still morning?
quest.event.daily.message.11117: Have you already got plans for the weekend?
quest.event.daily.message.11118: Who will you take with you today?
quest.event.daily.message.11119: Rah rah rah! I'll be cheering you on, so go do your best!
quest.event.daily.message.11120: You can't fight on an empty stomach. Did you remember to eat something?
quest.event.daily.message.11121: Is all your gear ready to go? Preparation is key!
quest.event.daily.message.11122: Gather lots of items so you can perform enhancements.
quest.event.daily.message.11123: Welcome! I'm happy to see you.
quest.event.daily.message.11124: I'm looking forward to seeing what you can do.
quest.event.daily.message.11125: Did you get a good night's sleep? Take care of your health.
quest.event.daily.message.11126: Looks like you're getting quite used to fighting.
quest.event.daily.message.11127: How's the weather today? What's the temperature like? Too hot? Too cold?
quest.event.daily.message.11201: Where do all these enemies even come from?
quest.event.daily.message.11202: We've seen lots of memories so far, and they've all been totally different.
quest.event.daily.message.11203: We fight, fight, and keep on fighting...
quest.event.daily.message.11204: What do you think lies at the very end of The Cage?
quest.event.daily.message.11205: Once you finish today's challenges, I'll tell you what my hobby is!
quest.event.daily.message.11206: Hey, so, I'm thinking of a really great line. I'll tell you what it is later.
quest.event.daily.message.11207: La la la♪ Goodness, I am just in such a great mood today.
quest.event.daily.message.11208: Did you know that one of my lines is particularly rare?
quest.event.daily.message.11209: Let's see... What's your fortune for today?
quest.event.daily.message.11210: I want to get myself a dog. Do you have one?
quest.event.daily.message.11303: 縺昴ｍ縺昴ｍ逶ｮ隕壹ａ縺昴≧縺ｭ\n 遘√ｂ謾ｯ蠎ｦ繧偵＠縺ｪ縺阪ｃ……
quest.event.daily.message.12101: Great work out there. How was it?
quest.event.daily.message.12102: Well done! How about we call it a day?
quest.event.daily.message.12103: Oh my. Thanks for taking care of that for me.
quest.event.daily.message.12104: You remembered to do it! My, aren't you something.
quest.event.daily.message.12105: Was that too easy for you?
quest.event.daily.message.12106: You did it again today? I hope I see you back here tomorrow!
quest.event.daily.message.12109: See? Took no time at all, right?
quest.event.daily.message.12110: Great work! What should we do next?
quest.event.daily.message.12111: Thanks! Did you work up a good sweat?
quest.event.daily.message.12114: Thanks! You've been a huge help!
quest.event.daily.message.12115: I'm sure the items you got will prove useful!
quest.event.daily.message.12116: I hope you have a great day!
quest.event.daily.message.12117: Having something to look forward to makes defeating enemies more enjoyable.
quest.event.daily.message.12118: I saw you fighting out there! Wow!
quest.event.daily.message.12119: Whew... My cheering make a difference, right? I sure hope it did.
quest.event.daily.message.12120: Looks like I was worried for nothing. You're in peak form today!
quest.event.daily.message.12121: Goodness. Maybe you didn't need any advice from me.
quest.event.daily.message.12122: Did you get any good items?
quest.event.daily.message.12123: Leaving so soon? Why not stick around?
quest.event.daily.message.12125: Are you a good sleeper? Nothing's more important than getting good rest.
quest.event.daily.message.12126: Your skills have come a long way. Time to aim for even greater heights!
quest.event.daily.message.12127: Gosh, I'm just such a worrier... I'm the type who's always holding an umbrella on sunny days.
quest.event.daily.message.12201: Doesn't matter, I suppose. All we need to do is beat every last one of them.
quest.event.daily.message.12202: Who knew there were so many stories out there?
quest.event.daily.message.12203: No matter how many we beat, they keep on coming. They sure are chipper, aren't they?
quest.event.daily.message.12204: Maybe we'll get there one day.
quest.event.daily.message.12205: My hobby is...coloring books! You should join me sometime.
quest.event.daily.message.12206: "There is more to the world than what meets the eye." ...Yeah, I admit it, I didn't make it up.
quest.event.daily.message.12207: Why am I so happy, you ask? Because you're here, of course!
quest.event.daily.message.12208: It barely ever pops up! Any idea which one it is?
quest.event.daily.message.12209: Today you have...Mama Luck! Wow, good for you!
quest.event.daily.message.12210: I'd love to rub myself up against one... They look so soft!
quest.event.daily.message.12301: Oh, sorry about that. You're here! My connection's not great today...
quest.event.daily.message.12302: Who did you think I was? Surprise! It's Mama!
quest.event.daily.message.12303: There we go, all fixed. Hm? Oh, don't worry about it.
quest.event.labyrinth.mob.message.100302: Thank you for\nall that you do.
quest.event.labyrinth.mob.message.100501: There is no end\nto the suffering...
